# gwae

> gwae: niri's scrolling tiling for your CLI agents, in any terminal (daemon-free, MIT)

> Your CLI agents, on a niri strip. No compositor required.

## Links

- [Repository](https://github.com/hongnoul/gwae): source code, issues, releases
- [README](https://github.com/hongnoul/gwae/blob/main/README.md): install and usage
